title: BTCPay Server Offers a 3 Bitcoin Bounty for Recovery of Stolen Funds After Wallet Exploit
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

BTCPay Server Offers a 3 Bitcoin Bounty for Recovery of Stolen Funds After Wallet Exploit

The open-source payment processor is funding a recovery bounty worth 10% of any funds returned, capped at 3 Bitcoins, and says it will prioritize security patches over new features indefinitely.

This post BTCPay Server Offers a 3 Bitcoin Bounty for Recovery of Stolen Funds After Wallet Exploit first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo.

title: BIP-110 Fork Stalls at Two Blocks as Bitcoin Miners Refuse to Follow
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

BIP-110 Fork Stalls at Two Blocks as Bitcoin Miners Refuse to Follow

A controversial proposal — supported by the Knots community — aimed at clearing up spam on the Bitcoin network, attempted to fork on Saturday. It failed spectacularly, picking up only a fraction of the mining power of the main Bitcoin network.

This post BIP-110 Fork Stalls at Two Blocks as Bitcoin Miners Refuse to Follow first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo.
